name: astra-browser
description: A Chromium-based browser inspired by Zen and Arc.

scripts.package: pnpm clean:release && pnpm build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.package:all: pnpm clean:release && pnpm build && electron-builder --mac --win --linux --publish never
scripts.package:mac: pnpm clean:release && pnpm build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.package:mac:arm64: pnpm clean:release && pnpm build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: pnpm clean:release && pnpm build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:all: pnpm clean:release && pnpm build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: pnpm clean:release && pnpm build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb tar.gz --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: pnpm clean:release && pnpm build && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
